name: Claude Fable 5.2
archDisplay: Proprietary frontier model (architecture and size undisclosed); adaptive thinking (always on) with selectable effort, 1M-token context, 128K max output, text+image in / text out
note: Anthropic's November 9, 2026 flagship, shipping as `claude-fable-5-2` on the Claude API, Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. List price drops 20% to $8/$40 per Mtok (Fable 5.1: $10/$50); cache reads $0.20, Batch 50% off, fast mode $16/$80. Default API effort is high; Claude apps and Claude Code default to Medium. Like 5.1, Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are the SAME model with different safeguard levels; this row is the generally available one, and the cyber and protein-design rows of the launch table (Mythos 5.2 only) are not filed here. The launch table is vendor-run at each model's highest-available effort with safeguards on. Anthropic publishes a row it loses: Gemini 4 Carbon leads AutomationBench (53.9 vs 51.4). NOT FILED: FrontierCode 2.0 (49.1, Xhigh) and OSWorld 2.1 offline set (89.3), new versions with no corpus column (same treatment as Gemini 4 Carbon); AA-Briefcase v1.1 (66.1) and the unlabelled Elo row under it (1785); Remote Labor Index (41.3), WANDR (82.1) and the internally run RoboDojo Sim (64.9), which have no column; Humanity's Last Exam with tools (74.2) and ARC Prize's ARC-AGI-3 Standard result (81.2, XHigh), both above the curated bounds of their columns (hle normMax 65, arc-agi-3 normMax 70), so they wait on a bounds decision. Vals AI's independent runs (Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.15, #1 of 63; Terminal-Bench-Science 55.71, #2 of 45) are not filed: Vals ran it with a 1.88% provider-fallback rate and shows no fallbacks-as-failures figure.
